question: At the qualified R16 actual-108 state and minimal width two, is the phase anchor necessary for collision-free nine-entity alias abstraction, or can any pair drawn only from the four derived context coordinates reproduce the full five-coordinate class membership?
hypothesis: Each of the four phase-plus-derived positive-control projections will reproduce the full five-coordinate nine-class membership, while none of the six derived-only pairs will do so. Thus the phase coordinate is necessary within the complete fixed width-two projection panel even though any one derived coordinate is sufficient when paired with phase.

prior_evidence.observation: Phase alone collapsed all twenty-seven surfaces into one class, while each of the four fixed phase-plus-derived width-two projections exactly reproduced the full five-coordinate nine-class membership.

scope_statement: This changes one R16 dimension: phase is excluded from the test projections. The complete six-pair set drawn from [prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1] is evaluated at the identical actual-108 state. Streams, selected motifs, seeds, budget, tuple width, exact set equality, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, or language-competence claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.full_five_coordinate_control: Exact R16 actual-108 records represented by sorted exact sets of [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.phase_plus_derived_positive_controls: Exactly four R16 arms in order [phase_anchor,prefix0], [phase_anchor,prefix1], [phase_anchor,suffix0], [phase_anchor,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.derived_only_pair_arms: Exactly six lexicographically ordered pairs [prefix0,prefix1], [prefix0,suffix0], [prefix0,suffix1], [prefix1,suffix0], [prefix1,suffix1], [suffix0,suffix1]. Every arm uses identical actual-108 records and exact projected-support equality; no byte is mutated.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R16 independent seeds; projections introduce no random draw.

controls: The local deterministic R16 probe must reproduce phase_plus_any_derived_minimal_sufficiency_supported before R17 output.
The full five-coordinate control must reproduce nine correct triplets with zero splits and zero cross-entity collisions.
All four phase-plus-derived width-two controls must exactly reproduce full-five-coordinate membership.
The complete six derived-only pair matrix runs once in declared order; every arm uses byte-identical actual-108 records and retains exactly two declared coordinates.
Entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction; labels enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R16 probe reproduces its frozen controls and classification before R17 output.

All ten width-two projections are constructed from identical actual-108 records; each tuple has width two, each coordinate index is unique and in range, and projection reconstruction matches the source coordinates.
All arms have frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited per evaluated arm.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.phase_necessary_at_width_two_supported: Validity and controls pass; zero of the six derived-only pairs reproduces full-five-coordinate membership.
classification_rules.phase_not_necessary_at_width_two: Validity and controls pass; at least one derived-only pair reproduces full-five-coordinate membership with nine correct triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but derived-only membership and audit results satisfy neither preceding rule.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R16, full-five-coordinate, or phase-plus-derived control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed ten-projection panel.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, arm-cardinality, projection, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R16 replication, full-five-coordinate control, positive-control projection, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R17 output begins, complete all six derived-only arms and frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not omit or add pairs, alter tuple construction, inspect alternate budgets, or change controls, metrics, thresholds, capacity, or classification after observing R17 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, coordinate pair, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R17 output.
